title: A maliciously crafted dynamic library, when loaded from an arbitrary path through the TextCommands.LoadDll command…
description: A vulnerability in Autodesk Fusion desktop application allows a maliciously crafted dynamic library loaded via the TextCommands.LoadDll command to execute arbitrary code. This occurs due to an exposed dangerous function that can be triggered when loading a DLL from an arbitrary path. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.8.
